text: A muscular male figure stands center, nude, with dark skin and short black hair. His face is angular, jaw prominent. He holds a long spear vertically, left hand gripping shaft near base. A swirling white energy trail arcs from his right hand upward. Behind him, five other figures—some crouched, some standing—hold spears or clubs. Background shows icy blue caverns with glowing purple light and falling snow-like particles. The scene is dimly lit, emphasizing the central figure’s silhouette against the luminous backdrop.
